title: Figure 38: contour plot of imaginary component of acoustic pressure, EPW=25
description: ANSYS 12.1 contour plot of the imaginary component of pressure (Pa) at 1,000 Hz with 25 elements per wavelength in water, for the uniformly radiating sphere model. Broad blue rings with legend from -379 to 2512 Pa. Part of the BAASS underwater acoustic wave propagation analysis.
